scope: Node VM model and callback audit of the real browser-tools module with local DOM stubs. No live UI, network, browser engine or credentials.

tests.name: Debug model is independent per tab and browser profile
Inspector selected tool survives switching browser tabs
Scoped cache clear leaves cookies, other origins and other profiles untouched
Whole-profile clear affects requested types only and preserves credentials/bookmarks
No checked data types cannot mutate site data
Open site data keeps unknown current origin selected instead of selecting another site
Clear callback retains captured profile if active profile later changes
Password Never and offer-save off stop save prompt
Autofill fixture is disabled at a different origin
Bookmark create normalizes URL and exposes selected-star state
Duplicate bookmarks cannot overwrite an unrelated bookmark
Bookmark URLs reject executable schemes and embedded credentials
Legacy bookmark migration filters credential-bearing URLs
Failed settings persistence never reports saved success
Syntax highlighting targets only code blocks, not the interactive inspector host
